title: Predicting Phenotypic Polymyxin Resistance in Klebsiella pneumoniae through Machine Learning Analysis of Genomic Data.
summary: The study evaluated genomic prediction on a 619-genome set with phenotype labels and reported predictive performance and genomic determinants. The model is limited to the studied strains and phenotype data; it does not establish clinical utility or resistance mechanisms beyond the tested evidence.
ai_technology: Machine-learning models used Klebsiella pneumoniae genomic features to predict phenotypic polymyxin resistance and were compared with a rule-based baseline.
